name: AI Summary Generator
author: justinjiajia

sections.description:
AI Summary Generator is an unofficial plugin that utilizes OpenAI-compatible APIs to automatically generate summaries for WordPress posts. It supports various AI models’ APIs and can be configured to work with different API providers. Therefore, it can be used with OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and other compatible services.

The plugin’s icon is an excellent Article icons created by Canticons – Flaticon
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository or upload it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page under ‘Settings’ → ‘AI Summary’.
  4. Enter your API endpoint URL, API token, model name, and other settings, then save the changes.
  5. The plugin will automatically generate summaries for your posts based on the configured settings. You can also manually trigger summary generation for existing posts at the post edit screen.
